children.description: An early navigation plugin designed to move with Ctrl+h/j/k/l across Herdr panes and wrap at workspace boundaries.

repo_info.description: Ctrl+h/j/k/l navigation that flows past herdr panes into workspaces — vim-aware, wraps at both ends

children.title: ugurtarlig/herdr-pane-picker
children.description: An early pane-picker prototype that overlays one-character hints on visible panes for direct keyboard focus.

repo_info.description: Pick a Herdr pane by typing its on-pane character hint

children.title: rbb/herdr-cursor
children.description: A design-stage Cursor integration intended to report Cursor agent states to Herdr so they appear alongside other agents in the status interface.

repo_info.description: A shim to provide a REPL around cursor SDK, to expose state to herdr via a socket.

children.title: malone-c/herdr-pane-balancer
children.description: An in-development layout manager that automatically rebalances pane sizes when splits are opened or closed, reducing cramped nested layouts.

repo_info.description: Keeps herdr panes evenly sized as they open and close. Splitting halves the focused pane; this rebalances the whole tab.

children.title: GoCodeAlone/mission-control-provider-herdr
children.description: An early Mission Control provider intended to use Herdr sessions as an external runtime.

repo_info.description: External Herdr session runtime provider for Mission Control

children.title: robinbraemer/herdr-axi
children.description: An early command-line interface designed to make Herdr workspace operations easier for coding agents to use.

repo_info.description: Agent-ergonomic CLI for Herdr terminal workspace operations

children.title: yoshimi-I/gengar.nvim
children.description: An early Neovim environment that keeps agents and Hunk-based diff review in Herdr while leaving Neovim focused on editing.

repo_info.description: Editor-first Neovim environment built for herdr — agents and diff review (Hunk) live in the multiplexer, Neovim stays an editor.
